csw:Record.dct:abstract: This dataset contains the processed Conductivity-Temperature-Depth (CTD) data collected on Mesocat voyage MC200332OC, processed by SRFME staff and is archived within the CSIRO Marine and Atmospheric Research Data Centre in Floreat. This dataset is part of the SRFME research program.
